title: My Broken Mariko
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Office worker Tomoyo Shiino learns that her childhood friend Mariko has died by suicide after a lifetime of abuse by her father. Wracked with guilt, Shiino takes a knife, steals Mariko's ashes from the family home and sets off to scatter them at a cape Mariko once wanted to see, confronting her own grief and despair along the way. A one-volume story.
life_message: It holds up loyal, fierce love for a friend and the choice to keep living while carrying grief.

content.note: Shiino breaks in with a knife; she is robbed on the road and confronts a stalker (Wikipedia).

Theft of ashes with a knife; near-suicide at the cape (Wikipedia).

delivery.evidence: Grief and friendship carried by a road journey per publisher summary; no delivery comment checked (to verify).
delivery.note: The story stays with Shiino's grief and anger rather than explaining a message.

winners_losers: No one simply wins: the abusive father is unpunished, Mariko is gone, and Shiino survives by choosing to keep living. Sympathy rests wholly with victims and those who love them.
